question: Orcish Bowmasters in as the third Game Changer — a flash ETB creature at mana value 2 that Meren re-buys: ping 1 and amass each return, the army is fodder, and it punishes extra draws; which card comes out?

contributions.text:
Answer: add Orcish Bowmasters only as a cheap, flexible body replacing a 2-mana fodder or value body — not as a Game Changer that must earn the slot. A modest fit; leaving the slot open is close to a tie.

1. Fit (argument). MV 2, so Meren returns it from 2 counters; each return pings 1 and amasses, and the Army is more fodder (S-6e55f400-02). Winding Constrictor should add a +1/+1 counter on each amass (a rules check). A small tempo-and-fodder engine; the deck's plan is a fatty back at end step with its ETB and death triggers, and Bowmasters adds little to that. No games, engine model or recon (S-6e55f400-01).
2. Play (argument). Flash it at end of turn or in response to an opponent's tutor or draw spell. Meren returns one card per end step: sacrifice Bowmasters only when no fatty needs the slot, or when a ping is the kill. Reassembling Skeleton already does "free fodder that doesn't spend Meren's return". Under Grave Pact each Bowmasters death is also an edict.
3. Slot. Bracket 3 allows up to three Game Changers (strategy:deckbuilding.power-level); the deck has two. The pilot declines overlapping cards (Braids over Grave Pact), and Bowmasters overlaps too. The goldfish saw it (S-6e55f400-04) but has no opponents, so it cannot price the draw-punisher half. Hold the slot unless the pilot wants anti-tutor/anti-draw punishment at his table.
4. Overlap and cut. Nearest in-deck: Toph, Scute Swarm, Archon of Cruelty (S-6e55f400-03) — the first two never-cut. Functionally closest to cheap fodder and pingers (Blasting Station already pings). Cut from the cheap-ETB-body group: Sakura-Tribe Elder first (mana is not the limit), not Stitcher's Supplier (it mills, the V26 theme). A lean, not a verdict.
open: does Winding Constrictor add to amass; does the pilot want an anti-draw card at his table?

call.pilot_words: eh... ok... forget it.. we only want clearly advantageous, obvious updates!
